failure_modes.recovery: Default categories are undeletable — rename your custom categories instead.
failure_modes.when: the category is one of the seeded defaults (default_category: true)

preconditions: id is required. Expenses keep their category_id; a deleted category renders as Uncategorized.

description: Deletes a custom category — categories are tenant-shared, so any tenant member can remove one regardless of who created it; the 9 seeded defaults are undeletable and refuse with CONFLICT (default_category: true). Expenses already carrying the deleted category keep their category_id untouched and simply render as Uncategorized; nothing is reassigned or blocked.
name: expense_category_delete
